reason: A WebUI utility for installing, uninstalling, validating, registering, activating, and hot-reloading DSH plugins from package, repository, archive, or local-directory sources.

summaries.zh: 通过 WebUI 管理 DSH 插件，支持从 npm、Git、tarball 或本地目录安装、卸载、验证、激活和热重载插件。
summaries.en: Manage DSH plugins from the WebUI by installing, uninstalling, validating, activating, and hot-reloading packages from npm, Git, tarballs, or local directories.

capabilities: Installs and uninstalls DSH plugins from npm, Git, tarball URLs, or local directories
Executes native DSH plugin management commands and package installation workflows
Writes plugin registration and bundle configuration
Validates plugin loading in a subprocess
Hot-reloads plugins and may load native addons into the running process
Copies agent preset files into the DSH home directory
